findings.claim: physical_delete now raises HTTP 409 for an ambiguous name, so a bulk purge (purge_all_trash, purge_all_missing, the trash purge job) can abort after earlier files were already unlinked and before their rows were committed.
findings.impact: Rows stay in Trash or Missing for files that are already gone from disk until the user purges again. A repeat purge succeeds because the unlink is skipped for an absent file. This is a rare state and not data loss.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/fileops.py physical_delete (existing_or_409 before unlink); the purge_all_* loops commit after the loop. Read from the diff only; the loop bodies were not opened.

bucket_proposal.reason: I12 requires 409 and no change for the ambiguous file itself. It does not define batch partial-state behaviour, and no test covers a bulk purge that meets an ambiguous entry.

findings.proposed_fix: Catch the 409 per file in the bulk loops and skip that file, or resolve every file before unlinking any.

specification_compliance: I1/I2: the read handlers go through _on_disk_path or resolve_on_disk(cached=True), and the tests cover the leaf, ancestor and both layouts.
I3/I4/I12: _walk tries the exact component first and then an NFC-equal scandir match. It treats '', '.' and '..' as matching nothing, and it writes nothing.
I5-I8: the mutating sites use existing_or_409 and new_or_409 without the cache, and name_taken covers the other spelling.
I13: the AST inventory test has a seeded-detector self-check and an empty LISTING_DERIVED.
I14-I16: out of scope for this core commit.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Many handlers were moved onto asyncio.to_thread with the request Session, including admin_markdown_images and uploads, which the touch-point list does not name.
start_import was split into prepare_import and launch_import.
physical_delete can now raise 409 in the middle of a batch.
regression_risks: Cross-thread use of the SQLAlchemy Session in the to_thread handlers.
Module globals in markdown_image_import (_jobs, _current_job_id) are now mutated from a worker thread.
A bulk purge can stop at one ambiguous entry.
Every resolve costs one extra lexists, and every miss costs a scandir on hot read paths.
test_coverage: Good coverage of I1-I12 through the layout matrix, including ambiguity 409, batch rollback, scanner stability and symlink rejection.
No test covers a bulk purge that meets an ambiguous entry, the complete_upload leaf resolve, or the thread offloading.
The inventory detector depends on the DRIVE_PART name regex, so a join with an unusual variable name can be missed.
